notes: numberFire (via FanDuel Research GraphQL getProjections type=REMAINING, position=NFL_SKILL) provides full remaining-season skill-player projections as of fetch (pre-Week-1 2026 ≈ season-long): pass completions/attempts, pass yards/TDs/INTs, rush attempts/yards/TDs, targets/receptions/receiving yards/TDs, and fantasy points for 521 skill players (QB=62, RB=128, WR=209, TE=122). Team abbreviations normalized (JAC→JAX, LA→LAR, WSH→WAS). Team offense yards/attempts/targets derived by aggregating numberFire player projections; approximate points_scored from offensive TDs + numberFire kicker XP/FG. numberFire D/ST remaining projections supply points_allowed/yards_allowed. Action Network futures API supplies consensus season-long player O/U lines for pass/rush/receiving yards & TDs, receptions, and team win totals (156 players with markets; 32 team win totals). Sean Koerner 32-teams series (5 teams published at fetch) adds fair-projection notes and picks. Vegas-implied season points scored (PPG*17) for all 32 teams taken from Sharp Football implied-totals tool (consensus DK/FD/MGM/Fanatics/Caesars as of 2026-08-31) because Action Network does not publish a season team total yards / points O/U board. Action Network weekly prop-projections page is PRO-gated. Pass/rush attempts and targets season O/U boards were not found on Action Network futures; those fields come from numberFire projections only.
errors: Action Network PRO prop-projections board empty/paywalled for logged-out users (no weekly PRO projection numbers captured).
Koerner 32-team season-prop series only had 5 team writeups published at fetch (ARI, CLE, CHI, PHI, NYG); remaining 27 teams not yet posted.
Action Network futures have milestone moneylines and season O/U totals but no pass_attempts / rush_attempts / targets season O/U markets.
No Action Network or numberFire native team season total yards / points_scored O/U board; team points_scored uses Sharp Football Vegas-implied PPG and numberFire-derived approx.
numberFire yearly/season projection type YEARLY returned empty; used REMAINING (equivalent pre-Week 1).
